verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST v3 Web API with per-endpoint reference pages, plus probes showing llms.txt and markdown docs. Nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. Markdown docs and llms.txt are adjacent machine-readable documentation, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
